title: Add named checkpoints for selective replay
description:
## Problem
Checkpointing is position-based today. The spec/backlog calls out named checkpoints to enable clearer execution traces and selective replay.

## Why it matters
- Better debugging and easier reruns starting from a semantic step boundary.

## Where this shows up
- `TECHNICAL_DEBT.md` → “Named Checkpoints” (Category 3).

## Proposed fix
- Introduce a named checkpoint API, e.g.:
  - `Step.run("fetch_data", function() ... end)`
  - `Checkpoint.clear_after("fetch_data")`
- Define behavior for collisions/duplicates and for renames.

## Acceptance criteria
- Named checkpoints can be created and cleared via DSL APIs.
- Backwards compatibility with position-based checkpoints is preserved.
- Tests demonstrate selective replay using names.
